title.narrative: Building inclusive and resilient health systems addressing health threats, environmental vulnerabilities and improved ecosystem management through a One Health approach

description.narrative: The project aims to develop a comprehensive One Health framework including implementation of effective Community Outreach programme and piloting the predictive disease models for early detection and risk mapping of zoonotic diseases in the districts, establish a digital platform to implement a One Health collaborative network for forewarning and mitigating risk of future pandemics involving key stakeholders from veterinary, public health, and environmental sectors. The key activities are as follows:1. Pilot Integrated dashboard analytics for disease outbreak predictions in Tamil Nadu and Telangana and digital platforms like Zoo-WIN in and 5 states respectively2. Pilot community one health outreach in Telangna and TN3. Development of a Policy brief on One Health offer by UNDP India4. Supporting Rabies and Snakebite helpline for citizens5. Implementation of RMNCH sensitive climate action plans

condition.narrative: The Implementing Partner shall ensure that all of its obligations set forth under the section entitled “Legal Context and/or Risk Management Standard Clauses” are passed on to each responsible party, subcontractor and sub-recipient and that all the clauses under this section entitled “Risk Management” are included, mutatis mutandis, in all sub-contracts or sub-agreements entered into further to the Project Document
